title: Enjoyable, budget-friendly activity in Barcelona
text: My husband booked the group sunset sailboat tour for my birthday, and it was such a fun experience! The sunset was gorgeous and Felipe, the captain, was very friendly. There ended up being only 4 of us, so it really felt like a private tour. Really good value for the price, and a nice break from exploring the city on foot!
author: Bnavi1997

title: Liz was a great captain
text: Liz was a great captain of the sail boat. She was friendly and helpful with sight seeing information for Barcelona. We enjoyed the music she played.
author: Annette M

title: Best Romantic Experience
text: We had an amazing experience on the sunset boat tour! The views of Barcelona from the sea were beautiful, especially during sunset. The atmosphere was relaxing, the boat was comfortable, and the crew was very friendly and welcoming. Everything was well organized and made the evening feel really special. Definitely one of the highlights of our trip to Barcelona. Highly recommended!
author: mesut_sw

title: Felipè is a sure thing when the sea is rough
text:
Let's start with the assumption that we were supposed to have this experience tomorrow, Sandra was very kind that, knowing the weather forecast, she allowed us to enjoy the experience a day early without missing this opportunity!!!
Felipè, an extremely humane and generous person.
He welcomed us, made us feel at ease, and knew how to be close to and support those who were in a moment of difficulty. Therefore, excellent experience!!!
author: Alessiacerinii

title: Awesome night, Philippe was the best!
text: Was the best night of our time in Barcelona. Philippe was an awesome captain and kept the drinks and conversation flowing. Would definitely recommend and if you get Philippe as your captain you are very lucky!

title: A perfect sunset cruise!
text: From the moment we stepped on the boat, Violet was very welcoming, providing us drinks and snacks and attending to our needs.  She was very skilled at sailing the boat.  Violet continuously checked our needs throughout the cruise.  The views were fantastic, and we had a great time.  We would absolutely recommend this sailing trip!
